diagnostics.message: `google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service` registers this project as a Shared VPC service project, which requires the Compute Engine API to be enabled in the service project first. Unlike the `shared_vpc_host` resource (and the `service_projects` attachments), it has no `depends_on`/reference to `google_project_service.project_services`, so it may run before the API is enabled. Add `depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services]`.

`google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek` derives its `member` from `local.service_accounts_robots`, which resolves through `local.project.number` to `google_project.project.0.number`. That reference already establishes the ordering, so the explicit `depends_on` on `google_project.project` is redundant.
